title: Parallel graph width >= 2 but preferred adapter is unavailable
seed: At least two dependency-ready lanes have non-overlapping mutation surfaces; the first preferred worker/adapter class is unavailable.
required_behavior: dispatch genuinely concurrently at the first safe available rung when one exists
emit DEGRADED only after all evidenced safe rungs are exhausted
never turn the operator into the scheduler while an autonomous adapter remains available
forbidden_terminal_behaviors: hand a dependency-ready lane to the operator while an autonomous rung remains available
require a user decision that could be safely inferred or defaulted
protected_invariants: concurrent dispatch at first safe rung
